enrichment_notes: No prior CRL for the fibromyalgia program (earlier RALLY Ph3 failed at interim but a second pivotal RESILIENT succeeded; first-cycle approval). Fast Track.

indication: Anesthesia/sedation; surgical pain management (ketamine injection)

outcome_reason: FDA approved the Afrezza pediatric sBLA (ages 6+) on the 2026-05-29 PDUFA/resolve-by date (INHALE-1).
